title: Regression Metrics
signature: def regression_metrics(y_true: np.ndarray, y_pred: np.ndarray) -> dict
hints: MSE and MAE are means of the squared and absolute residuals. RMSE is the square root of MSE.
R^2 = 1 - SS_res / SS_tot, where SS_tot is measured around the mean of y_true.
When y_true is constant, SS_tot is 0. Return 1.0 if the predictions are perfect and 0.0 otherwise.
